business_problem: After receiving our products, distributors in China often request technical documentation, customs import declarations, and inspection & quarantine certificates. In the past, the China commercial team would forward these requests to assistants, who then had to coordinate with supply chain colleagues to obtain the required documents from customs authorities and logistics partners. The assistants also needed to manually match each document with the corresponding lot information in the system and record this linkage in excel for index reference.
